title: Strategic Partner Sprint Voucher System for Scoped Commitments
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Create a lightweight voucher mechanism that lets Sales/Customer Success reserve a bounded amount of engineering runway (sprint-equivalent credit) for a strategic partner escalation. Vouchers are non-transferable, timeboxed tokens that map to scoped deliverables (e.g., SLA tuning, integration adapters, or UI adjustments). The system must integrate with billing for cost-offsets, the Console for visibility, and the intake pipeline so PMs can convert vouchers into scope without breaking roadmap SLAs.
acceptance_criteria: CS/Sales can issue a voucher via a Console flow and attach it to an account with a reason and scope summary
Voucher issuance creates an immutable ledger entry with audit metadata and links to the intake ticket
Voucher redemption converts to a scoped, timeboxed work item in Linear with estimated points and an owner
Billing reflects voucher accounting as a credit or offset with clear line items for finance
Telemetry surfaces voucher issuance/redemption rates, average time-to-redemption, and impact on roadmap allocation
Rollout includes a canary to 3 enterprise accounts and a rollback path that returns unused voucher credit
work_items: Finalize PRD and acceptance flow: due 2025-03-01
Design: Console voucher issuance and account view (mockups)
API: voucher ledger CRUD + redemption endpoint
Backend: ledger service + integration with entitlement and billing
Billing: accounting mapping + invoice credit flow
Linear automation: redemption -> create scoped issue template
Telemetry: dashboard and alert for voucher saturation
Docs & runbook: CS playbook, finance runbook, engineering rollback guide
E2E tests: issuance -> redemption -> billing reconciliation

decisions: Vouchers are non-transferable and expire after 90 days by default
Redemption creates a scoped Linear ticket with a standardized template (points, acceptance criteria, owner)
Use existing entitlement service for membership checks and a small append-only ledger in Postgres for audit
Apply cost offset as a billing credit line on next invoice rather than a retroactive refund to simplify bookkeeping
blockers: Billing team bandwidth to implement GL mapping and invoice credit line item
KMS rotation alignment for voucher signing — security needs to confirm compatible signing strategy
Legal signoff on enterprise addendum clause for voucher terms
